description: Use when someone pastes a token contract address, or asks whether a specific token is a rug pull, a scam, a honeypot or safe to buy. Runs the same automated check as dexsheet.com/rug-check/ (any token on solana, ethereum, base, bsc, arbitrum, robinhood, hyperevm, listed or not; 5–20 seconds for a token we have not checked) and answers verdict first: "passed", "new" (no failed checks but young or with warnings), "flagged" (a failed check: no trade), "failed" (a fatal finding: do not buy) or "unrated" (no verdict). Returns SheetScore (0–95) and band, the reasons, what the person can check themselves, ONE next step (swap on DexSheet with their own wallet for passed/new tokens, nothing for flagged/failed/unrated), the dated page URL to cite, and the check time. For a ticker or name instead of an address, use check_token.

address.description: Token contract address: Solana base58 (case-sensitive) or EVM 0x… . "<chain>:<address>" also works.

chain.description: Optional chain: solana, ethereum, base, bsc, arbitrum, robinhood, hyperevm. Solana addresses are detected; for a 0x address we find the chain it trades on.

name: rug_check
title: Rug check a token by contract address: verdict, reasons, next step
